description:
In the early 1900s, quack doctors sold “asthma cigarettes” cigarettes marketed as medicine. These so called remedies were packed with toxic herbs that could make people dizzy, hallucinate, or even struggle to breathe. They were advertised as a cure for asthma, bronchitis, and “nervous conditions,” but all they really did was poison the people.
